ginter-park-baptist.assessment: Ginter Park Baptist Church is a BGAV church with female senior pastor Dr. Anita Laffoon (called 2022). BGAV affiliation and female pastorate indicate progressive Baptist theology. Baptist Theological Seminary at Richmond (now merged with Union Presbyterian Seminary) is a progressive institution. Not recommended for men seeking complementarian theology or conservative evangelical alignment.

score_notes.christology: Trinitarian per historic Baptist identity but no explicit statement on site; progressive trajectory.
score_notes.scripture: Progressive hermeneutic implied by full LGBTQ affirmation; Rule of Life replaces confessional scripture statement.
score_notes.gender: Website explicitly welcomes 'every gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation' to 'full participation' including ordination — full affirmation = black.
score_notes.leadership: Progressive congregational model; affirming of women and LGBTQ+ leadership.
score_notes.soteriology: 'Radical acceptance' framing displaces substitutionary-atonement/sola-fide evangelical gospel.
score_notes.cultural: Fully captured by progressive/affirming theology per church's own 'Rule of Life.'
score_notes.denominational: BGAV historically; affirming trajectory aligns with Alliance of Baptists / CBF progressive wing — black on MOOP rubric.
score_notes.preaching: Social-justice / radical-inclusion topical preaching typical of affirming BGAV/Alliance congregations.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: No men-specific discipleship visible on site.

ginter-park-baptist.gender_detail: Affirms ordination and marriage for LGBTQ+ and all gender identities.

girard-bible-church-girard-ks.assessment: Listed in the 9Marks Church-Search directory. 9Marks publishes the directory as a discoverability tool for Reformed Baptist-leaning, congregationalist, expositional churches that self-identify with the 9 Marks of a Healthy Church (Mark Dever). NOTE: Inclusion is user-submitted via 9marks.org and is NOT individually vetted by 9Marks editorial staff. Treat directory presence as a self-attested signal of alignment with the 9 Marks values; confirm independently before publishing.
girard-bible-church-girard-ks.gender_detail: Verify on church website — 9Marks Church-Search listings self-attest to complementarian polity but the directory does not enforce.
